title: Libby preclinical-recommendation row
description: Ranked 'Preclinical recommendations' row synthesized by the preclinical_reporter from preclinical_pipeline.jsonl. The forward-looking companion to recommendations.jsonl: candidate ideas earlier than clinical development, ranked by promise for this patient's targetable features. NOT reviewed by the virtual tumor board — no persona fields.

candidate_id.description: Links back to the preclinical_pipeline.jsonl row this rec is built from.

targets.description: Snake-case targetable-feature identifiers this candidate acts on. First entry is the primary target; drives per-target grouping in the rendered table.

rationale_summary.description: Why this candidate earns this rank for this patient. Distilled from the pipeline row's rationale.

translatability.description: <= 25-word qualitative narrative for the at-a-glance table. Lead with a tier ('High in HGSOC PDX', 'Moderate', 'Low / cross-tumor only') + the load-bearing model or finding.

developability.description: <= 25 words: how far from a patient this is and what it would take (tool compound vs IND-ready vs approved-elsewhere repurposing).

description.description: <= 20 words. Mechanism-level risk that the candidate's own pathway could blunt the therapeutic goal.

counter_productive_moa.description: Mechanism-level counter-productive risk, same axis as the main recommendations table.

evidence_anchor.description: Supporting references as `pmid:NNNNNNNN`, `doi:...`, or `biorxiv:...` strings. Rendered as clickable links in the Key references column.

overall.description: <= 30-word declarative summary, rendered bold. Names the load-bearing tradeoff or scope, not the rank ordering.
